conceiveStatistics.fertility.lhEmptyText: Andika ibizamini vyawe vya ovulation kugira ubone ingene bigabanijwe.
conceiveStatistics.fertility.lhEvolution: Ingene ibizamini vya LH vyahindutse mu {{period}}
Ivyavuye mu bizamini vyawe vyanditswe uko ibihe bigenda.
Nta makuru ahagije aracari yo kwerekana ingene ibizamini vya LH bihinduka.
Uburebure bw'umurongo = umubare w'ibizamini vya LH vyabaye positive vyanditswe muri uku kwezi, muri kimwe {{count}} cakozwe mu {{period}}.
Uburebure bw'umurongo = umubare w'ibizamini vya LH vyabaye positive vyanditswe muri uku kwezi, muri vyose {{count}} vyakozwe mu {{period}}.
conceiveStatistics.fertility.mucusEmptyT: Andika ivyo warabiye kuri cervical mucus yawe kugira ubone ingene bigabanijwe.
conceiveStatistics.fertility.mucusEvolut: Ivyo warabiye vyanditswe uko ibihe bigenda.
Nta makuru ahagije aracari yo kwerekana ingene cervical mucus ihinduka.
Ubuyobozi bw'amaso: uko umurongo uba muremure, ni ko ivyo warabiye biba bisa n'ubwoko “{{eggWhite}}” — uva ibubamfu ugana iburyo: {{dry}}, {{sticky}}, {{creamy}}, {{watery}}, {{eggWhite}}.
conceiveStatistics.fertility.disclaimer: Uku gukurikirana ni icerekana cawe bwite. Ikizamini cabaye positive si ukwemeza ko wasamye.
conceiveStatistics.cycle.evolutionEmptyT: Andika itangura ry'imihango yawe kugira ubone ingene imisi y'uruziga rwawe ihinduka.
conceiveStatistics.cycle.infoText: Imisi y'uruziga rwawe ishobora guhinduka mu buryo busanzwe kuva ku kwezi ujana ku kundi — uku gukurikirana kugufasha kuraba ingene wewe uri.
conceptionOnboarding.tryingDuration.titl: Umaze igihe kingana iki ugerageza gusama?
conceptionOnboarding.tryingDuration.info: Urugendo rwa buri muntu ruratandukanye. AWA iri hano kugushigikira muri buri ntambwe.
Mbega ushobora kumenya igihe uri muri ovulation?
Nshobora gutahura neza ibimenyetso vya ovulation yanje.
Sinzi neza buri gihe, ariko mfise ibimenyetso bimwe.
Ntihagire ikikubabaza niba utarabimenya. AWA izogufasha kurabira uruziga rwawe uko ibihe bigenda.

Pima ubushuhe bwawe buri gitondo kugira ukurikirane ingene buhinduka.
Raba ingene ihinduka mu ruziga rwawe rwose.
Andika ibizamini vyawe vya LH kugira ukurikirane ukuzamuka kwa ovulation yawe.
Andika aya makuru mu ibanga no mu buryo bwiherereye.
